acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.

V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

history: Every00ET take original whole-date complete14day paired ETF maturity prefix, stop first unknown/not-yet-mature. Select source-ready whole dates, last120/min60. weights: Same exponential age63calendar-position sessions and dateESS normalization as v91. Each date mass split equally across all available clocks and both ETF sides. Both sides have identical total mass; no additional effective dates.
hypothesis: Learn conditional class corrections from both mature as-issued ETF candidates, then choose the highest positive expected net log return; do not condition training or new eligibility on the old winning side.
source: Frozen v88 price, publication-versioned calendars and completed issuer reactions; v90 body-reviewed 122 regular quarterly releases and 6 special-event markers for the same fixed eight issuers. Quarterly reported company revenue, not organic growth or pure semiconductor demand. Earlier regular same-quarter company guidance, not consensus or latest revision.
event_features: Latest visible earnings_call/release versions only, deduplicate by issuer and planned ET date; market_summary excluded. At ET date d and original official expiry date D: future dates d<=s<=D, count and max(1-(s-d)/14); recent dates 1<=d-s<=14, count and max(1-(d-s)/15). Empty sets yield0 only with complete reviewed catalogue. Event date is retained at all clocks including expiry date; day resolution does not assert occurrence before expiry close or actual release. Do not use actual early exit to choose window. Fixed four fields, no interactions/search.
event_availability: v86: exact publication timestamp -> next ET calendar midnight; source date without verified timezone -> date+2 ET midnight. Historical simulation convention, not measured receipt. Latest version per stable activity/kind, no future revisions. Catalogue cutoffs2023-01-01..2026-04-30. Current observed_at remains distinct. Missing issuer/expired coverage is unknown and aborts preparation / blocks action. Scope excludes other issuers, unscheduled activities and unarchived revisions. Extend and audit before case evaluation.
populations: Both ETFs at every ready historical source query in the same original fully mature whole-date prefix. Daily max120/min60 dates and original30eligible-date/old-baseline-ready gate retained for a matched study. Original eligible and top routes remain exact controls.
design: Global1,SOXSindicator,7clockdummies plus date-weighted standardized fundamental19 or reaction13 coordinates. No new thresholds/windows/features/search. Two sides share the fitted coefficient matrix and side-aligned features.
model: Same fixed regularized multinomial offset model q=softmax(log(p_as_issued)+ZB), lambda10 including intercepts; fundamental19/28design or reaction13/22design. New paired population fits each ET day; zero probability support remains zero and an unsupported mature trueclass blocks fit. Original source forecasts are immutable and inherited18models not refitted or changed. Convex projection from v92 at inference.
decision: Primary: bounded fundamental probabilities for each ETF times its existing four class netlog payoff means. Choose larger value, exact tie SOXL; buy if chosen value>1e-12 else CASH. Original source CASH may become a buy and original top may change only in newly registered paired routes. No holding-exit change. Fixed_top retains original top but releases eligibility; fixed_source also retains source eligibility. Source context/data readiness still required.
comparison: Keep all18v92 books byte-identical. Add six paired policies and own premarket/double-cost sensitivities (26books). paired_reaction removes six fundamental coordinates; paired_raw removes projection only; paired_fixed_top isolates side reselection; paired_fixed_source additionally retains original source eligibility; paired_identity uses issued paired priors with matched readiness. Controls never rescue failed primary.
verification: Independently reconstruct whole-date maturation, paired as-issued samples, date weights, features, scaling and every ready model gradient; independent optimizer anchors before outcomes. Verify all same-side/clock projection certificates and both candidate probabilities/values, all selected actions and complete capital/statistics. Original18 route events/CSV ledgers identical. Pair-candidate, selected-candidate and actual-entry diagnostics have distinct denominators.
limitations: Exposed historical development regression. Fixed8issuers selected before new evaluation, not historical index membership or complete news. Current archived results and earlier regular guidance are not consensus, earliest receipt or complete revision history. Reported revenue includes changing business mix;4scope cases remain unknown. Uniform2day delay. No guarantee of positive future months. Priors/readiness may still dominate information in six slow-moving issuer fields. Bounded inference is a deterministic interpolation constraint, not Bayesian uncertainty or reliable financial prediction. Same-side/same-clock contexts may be empty; that returns to the already-issued prior, not a market guarantee. Old13 and bounded routes are correlated uses of the same market history. Paired outcomes are OHLC hypothetical contract labels, not simultaneous executions or randomized treatments. Better candidate prediction does not establish selected-candidate calibration. No additional selection confidence calibrator is fitted on in-sample predictions. Source maturity and old eligibility readiness can still leave January without action.
reaction_features: Use asof latest visible planned issuer/dates within previous1..14calendar days. For each day e, r=first official session strictly after e, b=immediately preceding session. Use only after midnightET following r. Count ready distinct issuer/dates, arithmetic mean issuer excess log economic return vsSPY from b close to r close, mean other7issuer excess returns same interval, mean issuer log(economic daily volume at r /mean previous20officialsessions). Forward share factor incorporates effective splits only; one-day economic return=(close_r/futu_split_ratio+cash_ex_dividend_r)/close_b (no simultaneous split/cash supported). Empty observed set values0 with count0 and pending_count explicit; missing needed mature bars/actions blocks query/preparation. Current/future unresolved response is pending, not neutral realized return. No returns after r are used. Inputs uniform all8clocks in a day; no future actions scaling old rows.
fundamental_features: N matched latest issuers; mean(log(actual/prior_regular_same_quarter_mid)) over N; 2*mean(actual>prior_upper)-1 over N; K latest issuers with resolved reported-proxy scope and quarterly next guidance; mean(log(next_guidance_mid/latest_actual)) over K; mean calendar days since availability over N. Empty means zero only with explicit zero count. Exclude unresolved issuer comparisons and retain IDs/status. No stale fallback. Flip three directional log/breadth fields for SOXS, keep counts/age unchanged.
fundamental_availability: Publication date+2 calendar days midnight ET. Current archive historical simulation, not measured receipt, earliest publication or complete revision history. No future release, annual-to-quarter conversion, special-event replacement, or current unknown scope backfill. Reviewed query range Jan2023-Apr2026 only.
projection: For each daily fit, collect centered training correction vectors t_i=center(Z_i B) from exactly matching ETF side and clock. H=conv({0} union {t_i}). Raw query c=center(z B). Unique c*=argmin(u in H) 0.5||u-c||^2. q*=softmax(log(p_as_issued)+c*). Include all past context members, no outcome-dependent pruning, row/date threshold, quantile or cap tuning. No matching members gives H={0}. Same raw fit and context for all queries on the day.
projection_properties: Zero anchor implies norm(c*)<=norm(c); any pairwise correction c*_k-c*_j lies between min/max of zero and observed pairwise corrections. Every training correction is fixed. This bounds corrective odds, not absolute probabilities or future losses. Convex-hull membership in correction space is not feature-distribution support or a statistical confidence interval.
projection_numerical: Four centered scores span at most3dimensions. SVD rank threshold1e-12*max(1,largest singular value). Rank0->zero,rank1->segment,rank2/3->Qhull facets without jitter. Interior barycentric witness via mean-point triangulation; otherwise nearest facet point including all edges/vertices. Nonnegative weights sum1. Check max_i (t_i-c*) dot (c-c*) <=1e-9*max(1,norm(c)*max norm(t_i)); fail run if not. No outcome fallback on solver failure. Rank/barycentric tolerances are numerical only.
historical_comparison: v79 both_tilt used v78 gap_blend priors, four constant class biases and prohibited side or eligibility changes; failed with negative March/April. This version uses v80 as-issued recent_ratio priors, state-conditioned matrix and explicit new paired choice. Distinguish via same-source matched policies, not by comparing v79 and v93 returns as a causal attribution.
